subject: NovaCo integration: pentest artifacts, vuln SLAs and disclosure
messages:
From: Alex Harper <alex.harper@novacohealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@novacohealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up — pentest artifacts & questions for Redwood

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — quick follow-up from our security team. We completed our initial security review and have a few asks so we can move the NovaCo integration forward:  

1) Full pentest documentation: the vendor sent a one-page executive summary (attached). Can Redwood provide the full report or a redacted version and confirm what level of raw scan output you can share (Nessus/Qualys/Trivy outputs)?
2) Vulnerability management SLAs: what's your standard triage and remediation SLA by severity?
3) Scanning cadence and scope: internal authenticated scans vs. external scanning cadence; do you run continuous scans for third-party models/components?
4) Disclosure & redaction policy: how do you handle distribution of findings to customers and to third parties (redaction tiers, embargo windows)?

We want to kick off a vendor security questionnaire and can share our template (attached). If possible, put your responses and any artifacts in a secure upload location. Also copying ops@purplesec (their pen-test lab) who ran our scan; they can share raw outputs if there's a secure channel.

Next steps: can we get the Redwood initial responses by COB tomorrow? If not, a short call tomorrow morning for triage works too.

Thanks,
Alex Harper
Head of Security — NovaCo Health
attachments: nova_pt_summary.pdf, nova_vendor_questionnaire.docx

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@novacohealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, PurpleSec Ops <ops+purplesec@purplesec.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 19:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — pentest artifacts & questions for Redwood

Alex — thanks for this and for the attachment. Recap + proposed plan below. I put Dev (Platform Security) and Dylan (Integrations) on the thread to own the technical follow-ups.

Recap: you asked for the full pentest report (or redacted copy), raw scan outputs, our vulnerability management SLAs, scanning cadence details, and our disclosure/redaction policy. You also shared your vendor questionnaire.

What we can provide immediately:
- Redacted pentest PDF (we attach a customer-safe redaction today) and a tokenized link to the raw scanner exports via our secure upload (we will only provide raw outputs under a mutual NDA / secure S3 with access logs).
- Vulnerability management SLA (summary below) and the current vulnerability inventory CSV for your review (attached).
- Scanning cadence: external weekly unauthenticated checks, authenticated scans every 7 days for infra components, daily regression checks against critical detection signatures; annual red-team exercise.
- Compliance posture: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in-scope for our hosted inference plane; we support GDPR controls and have an optional HIPAA addendum for covered customers.

Proposed next steps (suggested timelines):
1) We upload a redacted pentest PDF and the vulnerability inventory to the Drive link by EOD today. (I will attach the redacted file.)
2) If NovaCo needs raw scan output, we'll require a short NDA and a secure upload — Dev will send the DocuSign link and upload details.
3) Schedule a 30-minute triage call Monday to go over high/critical findings, owners, and remediation timelines.

Initial SLA summary (high level):
- Critical (RCE, data exposure): acknowledge within 4 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours, patch/mitigation deployed within 7 business days where feasible.
- High (privilege escalation, chained exploits): acknowledge within 24 hours, mitigation plan within 5 business days, patch within 30 calendar days where applicable.
- Medium/Low: triage within 5 business days, remediation tracked in our backlog with target windows based on risk.

We redacted internal-only IPs and customer data from the summary attachment. If NovaCo has specific export requirements for raw formats, please list them so PurpleSec and our team can prepare.

I'll attach the redacted summary now and Dev will follow up with the NDA/upload link.

Best,
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_pt_redacted_novaco.pdf, redwood_vuln_inventory.csv

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@novacohealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, PurpleSec Ops <ops+purplesec@purplesec.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 20:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — pentest artifacts & questions for Redwood

Alex — quick technical clarifications from our infra team:  
- Raw output formats we can provide: Nessus .nessus export, Qualys XML, and consolidated CSV of findings. We cannot share unredacted customer telemetry; raw scanner exports are limited to footprint/scanner outputs.
- Upload mechanism: secure, expiring pre-signed S3 links (access logs & MFA enforced) or SFTP over our partner gateway. We'll require an executed NDA (DocuSign) before sharing. I will drop the DocuSign envelope in a separate email.
- Vulnerability scanning cadence detail: authenticated scans run every 7 days against the host fleet and model-serving nodes; external scans run weekly; container image scanning is continuous in CI, and we perform nightly dependency scanning.
- Remediation workflow: findings are created as tickets in our internal tracker and mirrored to customer-facing Jira when the customer requests visibility; we offer weekly remediation updates until closure for critical issues.

Attachments included for NovaCo: redwood_vuln_inventory.csv (current snapshot) and a template S3 upload instructions doc.

Dev
Lead, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
attachments: s3_upload_instructions.txt, redwood_vuln_inventory.csv

From: Alex Harper <alex.harper@novacohealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: PurpleSec Ops <ops+purplesec@purplesec.io>, security@novacohealth.com, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — pentest artifacts & questions for Redwood

Irene / Dev — thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. A couple quick points from our side:  

1) We can sign the NDA today; please send the DocuSign link.
2) For raw outputs we prefer Nessus .nessus plus Qualys XML where available; CSV is fine as a fallback.
3) On SLAs: can Redwood confirm that the 7-day patch window for critical items (where code changes required) is realistic for production workloads, or will some fixes need longer windows with compensating controls? We'll want that documented in the mutual action plan.

I'm attaching our vendor questionnaire filled with a couple of redlines. Also copying PurpleSec ops — if you can provide the raw scanner exports to the secure upload once NDA is in place, that will let us accelerate triage.

Proposed call: Mon 2026-11-23 at 10am PT — will that work for your team?

Thanks,
Alex Harper
Head of Security — NovaCo Health
attachments: nova_vendor_questionnaire_filled.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@novacohealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, PurpleSec Ops <ops+purplesec@purplesec.io>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — pentest artifacts & questions for Redwood

Alex — perfect. I'll send the DocuSign NDA in the next 20 minutes (Dev noted) and we'll provision an expiring S3 link for the requested formats once that's complete.

On SLAs: the 7-day target for critical code changes is our aggressive internal goal when a code push is required; for high-risk production issues we often do emergency patching or temporary mitigations (WAF rules, feature flags) to reduce exposure while the fix is implemented. We'll capture the exact remediation windows in the mutual action plan so NovaCo has documented expectations.

Call confirmed: Mon 2026-11-23 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite to follow. Agenda: high/critical findings, proposed owners, remediation windows, raw artifacts access flow.

Links: Drive folder with redacted report + inventory: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEXAMPLE
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/9876

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the triage.

Best,
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
